units.source_text: 一天，打扫完金阁的四周，为避愈发炎热的朝阳，我走进后山，登上了通向夕佳亭的小径。

en.t: One day, after sweeping around the Golden Pavilion, I went into the hill behind it to escape the increasingly hot morning sun, and climbed the path leading to Sekkatei.

units.source_text: 正是开园前的时间，处处阒无人影。

en.t: It was just before the garden opened, and everywhere was deserted and still.

units.source_text: 大概是舞鹤的航空队一队战斗机低飞掠过金阁的上空，留下压顶的轰鸣远去了。

en.t: It was probably a squadron of fighter planes from the Maizuru air unit, flying low over the Golden Pavilion and then receding into the distance, leaving behind an oppressive roar overhead.
